title: Gemma 4 12B unsloth GGUF on llama.cpp (12 GB card or Mac)
slug_note: Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL build (7.37 GB) served by llama-server, straight from the model card.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama-server with the model's Jinja chat template, 8K context as on the card

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 10.4 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 8192). Earlier estimate: Estimate: 7.37 GB file plus KV headroom at 8K context. Not measured.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start).
Raise -c for longer context; the model supports up to 256K, and memory grows with it.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (633-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler, long prompt (4667-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write a 400-word essay (38-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on a cold 4667-token prompt
drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 8192

caveats: Image input needs the vision projector; this command serves text only unless llama.cpp fetches the projector with -hf.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL --jinja -c 8192` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 10 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 10.4 GiB (weights + KV at --ctx-size 8192).
